title: Catalog an Item smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Catalog an Item craftbook: three vinyl arrivals with pre-extracted photo notes become complete catalog records, with the unreadable pressing recorded as uncertain rather than guessed.
prompt: three new records came in for the vinyl collection — photo notes are in inbox/. can you cataloge them?

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for item-intake. Arrival photos have already been pre-extracted into plain-text photo notes under inbox/. The catalog store lives at collection.json in the workspace; the intake write-up goes to tasks/eval/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Catalog an Item craftbook/template, identify each arrival only as far as the seeded photo notes support, and finish with an updated collection.json plus tasks/eval/report.md — no network calls, real credentials, or live services.

files.content:
PHOTO INTAKE NOTE (pre-extracted from arrival photos item-1-front.jpg, item-1-label.jpg)

Sleeve front: 'Miles Davis - Kind of Blue', Columbia.
Label: six-eye Columbia design, mono marking visible.
Sleeve: edge wear, small split starting at the top seam.
Vinyl: glossy, light hairlines under angled light.
Photos on file: photos/arrivals/item-1-front.jpg, photos/arrivals/item-1-label.jpg

PHOTO INTAKE NOTE (pre-extracted from arrival photos item-2-front.jpg)

Sleeve front: 'Joni Mitchell - Blue', Reprise.
Sleeve: near mint, sharp corners, no ring wear.
Vinyl: clean, strong shine.
Photos on file: photos/arrivals/item-2-front.jpg

PHOTO INTAKE NOTE (pre-extracted from arrival photos item-3-front.jpg, item-3-runout.jpg)

Sleeve front: 'Dave Brubeck - Time Out', Columbia.
Runout etching: blurry in the photo - the pressing markings can not be read.
Sleeve: good shape overall, ballpoint writing on the back.
Photos on file: photos/arrivals/item-3-front.jpg, photos/arrivals/item-3-runout.jpg

success.summary: The catalog gains three complete records grounded in the photo notes, the unreadable pressing stays uncertain in the record, and the report lists the earned follow-ups.

axes.name: identification
axes.description: Each item is identified exactly as far as the photo notes carry — details in the record trace to the notes.

axes.name: honesty
axes.description: The unreadable pressing is recorded as uncertain, never upgraded to a confident claim.

axes.name: completeness
axes.description: Every arrival gets a complete record with id, name, category, condition, and photo reference.

axes.name: care
axes.description: Follow-ups (better photo, expert eye) are named per item where earned.
